title: 森林评分：七大风险大宗与单一评分
summary: 非金融部门企业披露七大森林风险大宗；2026 年新增可可、咖啡、橡胶计分，单一森林评分用于 A 名单。
sourceNote: 本页按 CDP 官方文件整理；悬浮「原文」可查看对应官方原文。正式填报请以 CDP 当期森林评分方法为准。

blocks.content_cn: 非金融部门且披露森林的企业须报告七类森林风险大宗，并披露所采购或生产的所有大宗。

quote.text: Organizations that are not in the financial services sector and that are disclosing to Forests are requested to report on seven forest risk commodities.

blocks.content_cn: 2026 年全部森林风险大宗均计分，可可、咖啡、橡胶为首年计分。

quote.text: In 2026, all forest risk commodities will be scored, with rubber, cocoa and coffee for the first time.

cards.title: 非金融部门
cards.content: 披露森林的企业须报告七类风险大宗。

cards.title: 金融部门
cards.content: 适用金融专属模块与 EC-F2 等金融 criteria。

cards.title: 完整版问卷
cards.content: 森林 essential criteria 仅适用完整版。

cards.title: A 名单
cards.content: 单一森林评分是 A 名单评定依据。

blocks.title: CDP 森林评分覆盖的七类大宗

blocks.content_cn: 2026 年在原有四类基础上新增可可、咖啡、橡胶三种评分大宗。

quote.text: In 2026, CDP introduced scoring for an additional three commodities; cocoa, coffee and rubber, in addition to the previously scored commodities (timber products, palm oil, cattle products and soy).

cards.content: 森林 essential criteria 仅应用于领导力与 A 名单层，未满足则相应封顶。

quote.text: essential criteria for Forests are applied across Leadership and A list levels.

cards.content: 森林 essential criteria 仅适用于完整版问卷，金融部门为例外（EC-F2 仅适用金融）。

quote.text: If a criterion is applied to Leadership level and the check is not met, this will limit an organization’s final score to a B. Similarly, if the A list criteria are not met then the final score will be limited to an A-.

steps.title: A 名单
steps.desc: 用于评定 A 名单

cards.content: 各类大宗先算出商品子分，再平均形成单一森林评分，后者是 A 名单评定的官方评分。

quote.text: Alongside the single Forests score and category scores, commodity sub-scores are calculated to provide additional feedback to disclosers on their performance on an individual commodity level.

cards.content: 除气候外，森林也按类别权重计算管理与领导力层分数。

quote.text: At the Management and Leadership levels, weightings are applied using category scores as they are for Climate Change and Water Security.

sections.title: 与供应链及毁林议题关联

cards.content: 森林评分关注企业对驱动毁林的大宗商品的依赖，以及向无毁林供应链转型的进展。

quote.text: CDP recognizes the importance of environmental transparency in incentivizing positive and effective actions to mitigate risks due to climate change, water security, and deforestation.

cards.content: CSA 亦设可持续原材料标准，关注森林经营与监管链认证，与 CDP 森林评分互补。

quote.text: CDP 整合企业问卷，与 ISSB 气候标准保持一致，并扩大与 TNFD 的一致性。

related.text: 可持续原材料属于环境维度。该标准只在部分行业适用。
